prompt.text:
Implement a new in-memory document-preview controller. Export `DocumentCandidate`, `PreviewSnapshot`, and `DocumentPreviewController`. `select(candidate)` accepts only media types beginning with `text/`, a non-empty trimmed name, and a non-empty byte array whose values are integers from 0 through 255. A valid selection replaces the preview, makes it visible, clears the error, and returns `true`. An invalid selection clears the preview, hides it, sets a non-empty error, and returns `false`. `toggle()` changes visibility only when a preview exists. `clear()` removes the preview and error. `snapshot()` must return a fresh object and fresh byte array. Mutating the candidate or any returned snapshot must never change later snapshots.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
